Name: Scrollable (And More Informative) Level Up Menu
Author: zombifier
Description:
[youtube]kbkNU1QfAAY[/youtube]

Currently, if you have lots of mods that add new recipes that are unlocked by skill levels, this can cause the level menu to overflow and go past your screen, preventing you from seeing the recipes at the bottom or the OK button. This mod fixes this with the revolutionary technology of Scrolling™, allowing you to view every recipe, no matter how many mods you have! The menu automatically scrolls on its own, but you can also manually scroll it with mouse wheel/right analog stick.

Optionally, if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50688]Mod Name Tooltip[/url] is installed, this mod also shows which mod adds a certain recipe. Informative!

To install, extract the mod into your Mods folder as usual.

Mods in screenshot: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25426]Chocolate Valley[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url]

Android compatibility is not tested.

Source: [url=https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/ScrollableLevelUpMenu]https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/ScrollableLevelUpMenu[/url]
